_comment: Sample --studies-file input for main.py. patient_id 5 / facility_id 3 (Antioch) / client_id 1 match the TEST-P05 patient and CPT codes already seeded in migrations/0010 and migrations/0012 -- use these as-is against a dev DB that has those migrations applied, or substitute your own study_id/patient_id/facility_id/procedure_code values. modality_type is NOT an input field -- it's always derived from procedure_code via pc1.proceduresestimate (see get_studies.py).
